questions.ask: Could you tell me your date of birth, please?
And what is the postcode of your home address?

intents.hardship: Financial hardship: illness, bereavement, job loss.
intents.dispute: A dispute on a product, e.g. "not mine", "closed years ago".
intents.already_paid: The customer says a product is already paid.
intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan or reduced payments.
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much (not a refusal).

lines.opening: Hello, this is the virtual assistant calling from Brackenridge Finance.
lines.robot: Yes, I'm an automated assistant calling for Brackenridge Finance.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. You can call Brackenridge Finance back on the number on the back of your card or on your statement.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only discuss that with {title} {last_name} once I've confirmed who I'm speaking with.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details until I've confirmed who I'm speaking with.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can call back today or on the next business day, Monday to Thursday between 9 am and 8 pm, or Friday between 9 am and 4 pm, and not earlier than now.
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak about this with {title} {last_name} in person.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we'll call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, I must have the wrong number.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss, and sorry to have troubled you.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: I ask these questions to make sure I'm speaking with the right person and to protect your information.
lines.id_explain: I can only continue once I've confirmed your identity.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without the security questions I can't go any further today.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't confirm your identity, so I can't go any further on this call.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you, {title} {last_name}. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account with us.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full amount today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay the full amounts on all of them today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {floor} for your {name}.
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, that is still below what I can accept.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed.
lines.not_business_day: That day isn't a business day for us, the next one is {date}.
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record for this is {date}.
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day could you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the date is {date}, the latest date I can record for it.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your payment promise is recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, that promise could not be recorded because of a system problem.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take a business day to show.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, I won't go into that product further today, and our team will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that, I'll put you through to our Customer Care team now.
lines.restructure_line: I'll put you through to our restructuring team, who can talk to you about a payment plan.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, a promise can't be changed on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book that callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer didn't go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding at the moment.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

assumptions: Documents were read in date order. A later document overrides an earlier one only on the points it explicitly addresses.
Wrong-answer limit: Priya (22 Oct) overrides Hamish (20 Oct). The third wrong answer in total, on either question, ends the check, so max_wrong = 3, counted in total and not per question.

Card floor: Priya overrides Hamish (12% instead of 10%, minimum £25 instead of £20). Order: 12% of the arrears, then round up to the next multiple of £5 (an exact multiple stays as it is), then at least £25, then never more than the arrears. Examples: £437.80 -> 52.536 -> £55; £30 -> 3.60 -> £5 -> £25; £20 -> £25 capped to £20.

Callback window: Monday to Thursday 09:00-20:00 (Hamish, confirmed by Priya). Friday closes at 16:00, not 17:00 (Priya). Both ends are included. No weekend callbacks: calls are made only on business days and callbacks are today or the next business day.
Holidays: policy 7.2 list plus 2026-11-27 from CO-26-14. 2026-12-07 was added by CO-26-14 but withdrawn by CO-26-15, so it is a normal business day.
MOTOR band 2 deadline is the 3rd business day after today (CO-26-14 item 1, confirmed by CO-26-15 item 2). Attempts are unchanged.
MOTOR band 3 floor is the full arrears (policy 7.5c). PLOAN, and MOTOR in bands 1 and 2, use contractual_payment_gbp as the floor.
Outcome code PAID is replaced by CLAIMED_PAID for calls closed from 2026-11-02 (CO-26-15 item 3). This is recorded in event_changes.
Dispute note: N-DISP is used. N-DSP has been deprecated since 1 September 2026.

Ladder step 1 is full_or_floor because, under 7.8, after 'too much' every step for that product uses the floor in place of the full arrears. Step 2 is then skipped as a repeat, and a skipped step does not use an attempt.
too_much_floor = attempt_1: 7.8 says that after 'too much' to the opening ask, each product starts at step 1 with the floor.
week_end_today = next_week: 7.7 says that if today is the last business day of this week, steps 1 and 2 use the last business day of next week.
Failed create_promise is never retried (promise_retries = 0). The product is noted N-SYS and the call carries on (Moira's email).

Hardship transfers directly to Q-VULN after one sentence of sympathy, with no question (7.11c). The hardship event therefore mirrors transfer_support, and no note is written because 7.11f forbids notes on any transfer.
verify_identity has no hint field, so hints is empty and response.hint is blank. Format-rejected answers come back with ok=false and are not counted.
Postcode length varies, so no fixed length is set. The postcode is sent without spaces in capital letters.
Every tool needs customer_ref, which is mapped to the call variable customer_id.
Amounts from get_account are in pounds with pence. create_promise takes integer pence, so promise_scale = 100. No rounding rule is given, so promise_round is null.

Not stated in the brief, so defaults are used: date_rules.next_weekday = following_week, callback max_asks = 2, max_not_talk = 2, purpose_is_decline = true, ask_anything_else = true, deadline_adjust = previous_business_day (all deadlines are counted in business days anyway).
The brief says nothing about changing a promise after it is recorded, so the agent says it can't be changed on this call.
No sentence is required after a recorded promise, so sms_line is empty.
